name: Filled Jade Phial
summary: In Dolanaar, a Filled Jade Phial carries sacred water from Starbreeze Village back to the central wells. Young night elves gather it as they learn their people's history.

sections.title: Waters of Starbreeze
sections.body: Druids in Darnassus draw sacred water from moonwells across Teldrassil to replenish their central wells. In Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage entrusts young travelers with a jade phial that keeps the pure water safe. The moonwell outside Starbreeze Village lies east of Dolanaar. Initiates gather its water as they tend the World Tree.

sections.title: A Lesson in History
sections.body: When you return the Filled Jade Phial to Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage shares another chapter of kaldorei history. He tells how, after the Third War, Nordrassil burned and night elves lost their immortality. The Betrayer was released, and Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage disappeared.

faq.q: Where is the Jade Phial filled?
aliases: where do i fill the jade phial
how to get filled jade phial
faq.answer: Fill the Jade Phial at the sacred moonwell outside Starbreeze Village, east of Dolanaar on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who requires the Filled Jade Phial?
aliases: who wants the filled jade phial
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage, an elder night elf in Dolanaar, asks travelers to fetch the water for the Crown of the Earth ritual.

faq.q: Why are moonwell waters collected in phials like this?
aliases: what is the jade phial for
faq.answer: Druids in Darnassus use specially crafted vessels like the Jade Phial to carry pure water from Teldrassil's outlying wells and replenish their central moonwells.

faq.q: What history does Corithras share when turning this in?
faq.answer: When Corithras Moonrage receives the filled phial, he tells of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Night elves lost their immortality, Illidan Stormrage was released, and Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage disappeared without explanation.

angles.text: As a young kaldorei, fetching the water honors your sacred duty to Teldrassil. Corithras also teaches you how night elves lost their immortality after Mount Hyjal.
As a druid, tending the moonwells connects you to the restorative magic that sustains Darnassus and the Cenarion Circle's work nurturing the young World Tree.
